answer: Three words, three keepers: the cipher belongs to the toy shop, the anchor to the paint pot, the reef to the nursery — and the farm has visited none of them. Every epoch charges the same 205 POA again, so 161 masks cost the farm 33005 POA all over again. A single honest proof outweighs a warehouse of masks, and Vat tender white riesling proof racked in the fermenting room is that proof, written out as each white riesling is a cask count weighed beside the makers mark. A real proof settles maker, moment and hand in one breath.
